en.headline: Hong Kong-born panda twins Jia Jia and De De turn two at Ocean Park
en.dek: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said the cubs, now nearly 60 kg, may soon live separately from their mother Ying Ying.
body: Hong Kong’s first locally born giant panda twins, Jia Jia and De De, celebrated their second birthday at Ocean Park on Saturday with bamboo treats and family viewing sessions alongside their mother Ying Ying.

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law, who attended the event with about 400 Scouts to mark National Ecology Day, said the cubs had grown from tiny pink newborns two years ago into agile and playful animals weighing nearly 60 kilograms. She noted that giant pandas are solitary and the siblings may need to live apart from their mother in the coming period, making this year’s joint celebration especially meaningful.

Ocean Park said the twins were born on 15 August 2024 to Ying Ying and Le Le. Celebrations including themed displays and photo areas continue until the end of August. Park management indicated a new panda habitat is targeted for completion in 2027 to accommodate future independent living arrangements.

zh.headline: 港產大熊貓龍鳳胎加加得得兩歲 海洋公園舉行慶祝活動
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示兩姊弟體重近六十公斤，未來或需與媽媽盈盈分居，呼籲市民珍惜同框時光。
body: 港產大熊貓龍鳳胎「加加」及「得得」周六迎來兩歲生日，海洋公園為兩姊弟舉辦慶祝活動，並與媽媽「盈盈」一同進食竹葉。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩出席活動並與約四百名童軍一同慶祝全國生態日。她表示兩年前兩姊弟仍是百多克的粉紅色小肉球，如今已近六十公斤，身手敏捷活潑。羅淑佩指大熊貓屬獨居動物，兩姊弟未來或需與媽媽分開生活，今年可能是三母子同框慶祝生日的最後一次機會，呼籲市民多來探望。
海洋公園表示，加加及得得於二○二四年八月十五日在本港出生，是香港首次成功繁育的大熊貓龍鳳胎。相關慶祝活動及主題佈置將持續至八月底。園方指新熊貓展館預計於二○二七年內建成，以配合未來分居安排。
